node.title: Far-CA as a split-locator Hankel pencil
node.statement: For every RS code and 1<=r<=n-k, a syndrome is within radius r exactly when its (n-k-r) by (r+1) Hankel matrix has a kernel vector that is the coefficient vector of a monic squarefree degree-r locator split over the evaluation domain. A received pair is column-close exactly when the two Hankel kernels share such a locator. Hence for a column-far pair, CA-bad slopes are exactly the parameters where the syndrome Hankel pencil has a domain-split kernel locator. At the first official transition, the missing r+1 bound is an exact supported-slope split-pencil census.
